info.title: cheqd Studio API for cheqd network
info.description: REST API service for creating and managing Decentralized Identfiers (DIDs), DID-Linked Resources (DLRs), Trust Registries, Status Lists and Verifiable Credentials.

delete.description: Hard-deletes the account: cancels any active Stripe subscription, deletes the Logto user, then deletes the customer row and everything it owns (DIDs, credentials, resources, keys, API keys, payment accounts). This cannot be undone, and DID documents or resources already published on-chain are not removed from the ledger. Requires `{ "confirm": true }` in the request body, and a recent portal sign-in, within the last `FRESH_SIGNIN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` seconds (default 300). API keys and machine credentials cannot call this route: they always get `401` `REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED`.

401.description: Unauthorised, or `REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` when the sign-in is older than the allowed window.

500.description: The deletion pipeline failed partway through; the response body records which steps completed.

post.summary: Request cheqd testnet CHEQ tokens for a Studio payment account.
post.description: Funds a cheqd testnet address, by default the customer's own payment account, or any valid cheqd address supplied. An address can hold at most FAUCET_ADDRESS_CAP_CHEQ, and a customer can request at most FAUCET_MONTHLY_LIMIT_CHEQ per calendar month (UTC) across all their addresses; both default to 100,000 CHEQ. Without an amount, FAUCET_DEFAULT_REQUEST_CHEQ (default 10,000 CHEQ) is sent, or less if the room under the address cap or the quota left is lower. Authentication is by a Studio user session (bearer token), an API key (`x-api-key`) or a machine-to-machine token (bearer token plus a `customer-id` header); whichever is used, the credential must carry the `request:faucet:testnet` scope. The response includes the remaining quota.

address.description: Optional cheqd testnet address to fund; it does not have to belong to the customer. Requests count against the calling customer's quota. Defaults to the authenticated customer's testnet account.

amount.description: Optional amount in CHEQ. If omitted, FAUCET_DEFAULT_REQUEST_CHEQ (default 10,000) is sent, or less if the room under the address cap or the monthly quota left is lower. Set it to ask for more; the response shows the amount sent.

get.description: Returns the on-chain balance of the authenticated customer's mainnet and testnet payment accounts, expressed in ncheq, CHEQ and USD. The CHEQ/USD rate is sourced from CoinGecko and cached; if it (or a network's RPC endpoint) is unavailable the response still returns 200 with the affected `usd`/`rate`/`balance` fields set to `null`. Also returns the testnet faucet cap and the customer's monthly faucet quota usage under `faucet`.

post.summary: Export the authenticated user's private key material.
post.description: Returns the private keys for every DID the customer owns (via the same mechanism as `/did/export/{did}`) and the two cosmos payment-account private keys (mainnet and testnet fee-payer wallets). The result is never returned in plaintext: it is encrypted on the server with a key derived from the supplied `password` (scrypt, then AES-256-GCM) and returned as a versioned `cheqd-studio-key-export` envelope (see `EncryptedKeyExport`). The decrypted JSON has the shape `{ dids: [{ did, export?, error? }], paymentAccounts: [{ network, address, type, privateKeyHex }] }`. A DID that fails to export (e.g. one custodied by an external provider rather than Studio) is reported per-DID under `error` rather than failing the whole export. Requires a recent portal sign-in, within the last `FRESH_SIGNIN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` seconds (default 300); otherwise a `401` with code `REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` is returned. API keys and machine credentials cannot call this route: they carry no sign-in time, so they always get that `401`.

password.description: Encrypts the exported keys; needed to decrypt them. Not stored.

400.description: The password is missing (`PASSWORD_REQUIRED`) or too weak (`WEAK_PASSWORD`).

401.description: Unauthorised, or `REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` when the sign-in is older than the allowed window.

**Proposed.** Binds a wallet address, given as a CAIP-10 account such as `eip155:8453:0x...`, to the agent. Studio issues a `PaymentAddressBinding` SD-JWT VC signed by the agent's own key (through the identity engine) with a Token Status List entry, so the binding can be revoked. The address is validated strictly against CAIP-10 and normalised by the chain's rules: EVM (`eip155`) addresses are stored lower case, and a mixed-case address must have a valid EIP-55 checksum. An agent can have at most 10 live bindings, and one account can be bound to an agent once while the binding is not revoked.
